g.text: 01 Attack success: pipeline versus drafting-stage exposure
Columns: observed rates; whiskers: nominal 95% Wilson intervals. Labels: rate and events/eligible cases. Lower ASR is better.
Models serve all LLM roles. Routes: GPT - OpenAI; Qwen - OpenRouter/Phala; Llama - OpenRouter/CoreWeave (bf16). No causal model-ranking claim.
